description: Emmanuel Walter and Jérôme Kämpf at EPFL publish the files used to verify CitySim against BESTEST and monitored consumption values. The ZIP bundle contains the simulation inputs and a documented sequence for running CitySim, collecting outputs and analysing the results. A Windows batch file starts the simulations, Python gathers results and an Excel sheet performs the analysis. Zenodo distributes the September 2019 deposit free under CC BY 4.0 and cites the authors' 2015 Building Simulation Applications paper. The release is a verification bundle, not a geographic building inventory; its exact scenario coverage, model time steps and software-version requirements remain unknown from the landing page. It can support regression checks and comparisons of building-energy simulation results. The bundle was not executed. Its named simulation dependency is the existing model-citysim catalogue record.
